import.workbooks-not-found:
Recipe `{Section}` asks for {Count} workbook(s) that the source does not have: {Missing}.
Workbooks that are there: {Present}
import.sheets-not-found:
Recipe `{Section}` asks for {Count} sheet(s) that the source does not have: {Missing}.
Sheets that are there: {Present}
import.workbook-path-missing: Recipe `{Section}` reads workbooks from `{Path}`, which does not exist.
import.workbook-format-unsupported: `{Filename}` is not a workbook this tool can read. It reads `.xlsx`, `.xlsm`, `.xlsb` and `.xls`.
import.google-key-file-missing: Recipe section `{Section}` names service account key file `{Path}`, which does not exist.
import.google-key-variable-not-set: Recipe section `{Section}` reads its service account key from environment variable `{Variable}`, which is not set. The key is held in the environment so it need not be committed.
import.google-key-unreadable: Recipe section `{Section}` could not read a service account key from {Origin}: {Detail} A service account key has `"type": "service_account"`; an OAuth client secret goes in `ClientSecretFilename` instead.
import.google-client-secret-missing: Recipe section `{Section}` names client secret file `{Path}`, which does not exist.
import.log-cached-token-predates-scope: This machine's cached token was issued before Tabbit asked for `{Scope}`, and a cached token is not re-consented on its own. Delete `{TokenStore}` and run again: the next run opens a browser once to ask for it.
import.log-defined-name-no-range: Defined name `{Name}` of `{Document}` refers to no range. Skipped.
import.log-defined-name-not-a-range: Defined name `{Name}` of `{File}` refers to `{Range}`, which is not a range. Skipped.
import.log-defined-name-not-one-rectangl: Defined name `{Name}` of `{Document}` covers {Range}, which this importer cannot read as a single rectangle. Skipped.
import.log-defined-name-not-readable: Defined name `{Name}` of `{File}` refers to `{Range}`, which this importer cannot read as a single rectangle. Skipped.
import.log-defined-name-outside-sheet: Defined name `{Name}` of `{Source}` covers {Range}, which is outside the cells sheet `{Sheet}` has. Skipped.
import.log-drive-api-disabled: The Drive API is not enabled for the project this credential belongs to. Enabling it once is all this needs - Tabbit reads one metadata field and nothing else.
import.log-rows-read-short: `{File}` sheet `{Sheet}`: the workbook reader gave {Rows} row(s) fewer cells than the file holds, and {Recovered} cell(s) were read back from it. This is a defect in that reader rather than in the sheet - the cells are there and Excel shows them.
import.log-scope-not-allowed: The service account is not allowed `{Scope}`. If your workspace lists which scopes a delegated account may use, an administrator adds it there.
import.log-sheet-excluded: Sheet `{Sheet}` is marked as excluded and is ignored.
import.log-tab-excluded: Sheet `{Sheet}.{Tab}` is marked as excluded and is ignored.
import.log-until-granted-imports-everyth: Until it is granted, every run imports the documents whether they changed or not.
import.log-version-unreadable: Could not read the version of document `{Document}`, so this run imports it whether or not it changed.
